summary.name: Intelistyle
summary.one_liner: Intelistyle is an A.I. styling and fashion personalisation platform for online retailers, offering virtual try-on, outfit recommendations, and automated product tagging.
use_cases: Offering virtual try-on on a fashion e-commerce site
Showing complete outfits on virtual models instead of product carousels
Reducing studio photoshoot costs with virtual model photos
Enabling natural language search for shoppers
Sending outfit recommendations in retention emails
summary.what_it_does: Intelistyle provides AI styling for fashion retailers, aiming to personalise the customer experience and increase conversion and basket size. Its virtual try-on lets customers see how a garment looks on them, based on skin tone or body type. Outfit recommendations are shown on virtual or real models, and "Shop The Look" and visually similar product recommendations are offered for upselling. The platform also covers email recommendations, ad retargeting, and personalised landing pages, and it automates product tagging and supports natural language search. The page says integration is a single line for major eCommerce platforms.
notable: Virtual try-on that adapts to skin tone and body type
Full outfits shown on virtual models, not just product carousels
Automated product tagging and natural language search
One-line integration with major eCommerce platforms
caveats: Listed as paid (#paid) in the source collection; the page itself shows no pricing
Targets fashion retailers rather than individual shoppers
